odbijene_misli.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): The drop at Obilićev venac from 331 to 42 [F5] is only the gap between two receptions of a feed that publishes no measurement time [F4]. It could be old, and nothing links it to a Halloween crowd at Beograd na vodi, whose scope is unconfirmed [F6]. The 42 is also the citizen-sensor instrument count [F3], a numerical coincidence that carries no meaning, and SEPA has delivered nothing in the last 6 h [F2], so no air-quality instrument can support any crowd story.
razlog: reads silence as nothing having happened

odbijene_misli.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Observer's VMA swing from 548 to 302 [F5] is a difference between two receptions of a source that gives no measurement time [F4], so it may be a change in what the feed displays and not a change on the ground. Connector is right that reception clocks are not observation clocks: citizen sensors arrived 18 min ago [F3], Parking Servis 28 min ago [F4], and that is all the facts bind together. Observer's news thread is also unsupported as a city signal, since the headlines carry unconfirmed geographic scope [F7][F9].
razlog: puts words in a source's mouth - the record holds its values, not its statements
